paragraphs: A modern, responsive, and visually immersive travel & tour booking website.

ISEKAI is a frontend web application designed to inspire wanderlust and provide travelers with a seamless browsing and booking experience. From exotic mountain expeditions and sunny island getaways to luxury ship cruises and culinary adventures, ISEKAI offers curated packages and highlighted destinations across the globe.
Built with clean semantic HTML5, custom responsive CSS3, and interactive Vanilla JavaScript, the website delivers high performance and smooth navigation across desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
features: 📱 Fully Responsive Layout: Adapts gracefully to all screen sizes with a custom hamburger menu for mobile devices.
📌 Sticky Navigation Header: Smooth scroll-triggered sticky header with intuitive navigation links.
🚢 Curated Travel Services: Highlighting Ship Cruises, Food Tours, Summer Vacations, and Mountain Treks.
🏷️ Upcoming Tour Packages: Detailed travel cards featuring destination pricing, duration, and user ratings (e.g., London, New York, Dubai).
🌍 Popular Global Destinations: Showcases world-renowned wonders including Machu Picchu, Niagara Falls, Giza Pyramids, the Great Wall of China, Eiffel Tower, and the Taj Mahal.

requirements.text: 📬 Newsletter Subscription: Integrated newsletter signup for travel updates and exclusive offers.
